card.title: Chain of Command
card.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a teaspoon must go through the kitchen supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're standing beside the teaspoons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Physical proximity is not authority.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the kitchen supervisor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then countersign your request. I'll pass it up to catering.

card.title: Start the Hard Part
card.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

card.title: Chain of Command
card.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I lend you this ladder, your department head must ask mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're neighbours, cleaning our gutters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to establish departmental boundaries.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just borrow it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while the gutter committee remains unformed.

card.title: Start the Hard Part
card.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the difficult word.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I'll handle the words that come after it.
